application_sentences: rsal testing machine Inspekt duo 5-10kN Product catalog summary General Product Description: The inspekt duo universal testing machine by Hegewald & Peschke is designed for standard-compliant material and component testing in low load ranges.
It is a cost-effective, table-top machine with high bending stiffness, suitable for tensile, compression, and bending tests on various materials.
Applications: The machine is used for testing plastics, elastomers, lightweight materials, components, springs, foils, and textiles.
Additional Information: The inspekt duo series is not designed for connecting external electrical devices to the emergency stop circuit.
The inspekt duo is a cost-effective table-top machine of low weight and high bending stiffness suitable for tensile, compression and bending tests on various materials.

The inspekt Duo universal testing machine is also used for component testing, including cyclic testing of electronic components such as plugs and switches, as well as medical products such as syringes.
Specifications: The Inspekt series offers high measurement accuracy and versatility, suitable for both industry and research.
Features: The machines feature a modular design with variable geometry load frames, allowing for customization to test special specimens and components.
